XSD Terms You Need to Know

Released Nov 16, 2024, 4 min

Play XSD Terms You Need to Know on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

After covering the vocabulary you need from RDF, RDFS, and OWL, we still had a gap: we need to add numbers and dates and strings. To do this, XSD is essential. In this video, I cover the five most important XSD datatypes to get you off and running in building ontologies with OWL.

They are: integer, decimal, string (and language tags), date, and dateTime.
